articles.summary: We’re advancing the next generation of AI platform-enabled enterprise transformation. The Hackett Group® has launched XT™ Version 2, our AI-powered platform that brings together Hackett process and performance intelligence, client-specific context and expert guidance to accelerate transformation delivery. With Digital World Class® and AI World Class™ benchmarks, best-practice process flows and proven transformation frameworks embedded into the platform, XT™ helps turn transformation opportunities into actionable, financially grounded roadmaps designed to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Releases Next Generation of XT™, Advancing Its AI Platform-Enabled Enterprise Transformation Strategy

articles.summary: The Hackett Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HCKT), an enterprise AI transformation firm, today announced findings from its 2026 European Working Capital Survey, revealing that despite improving working capital performance, Europe’s largest companies continue to hold an estimated €1.26 trillion in excess working capital equivalent to 14% of annual revenue.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Study Finds €1.26 Trillion Remains Trapped in Working Capital Across Europe’s Largest Companies
